snippet.title: Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth Arrives August 1st!
snippet.description:
We are beyond excited to finally share the news — Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth is coming to Steam on August 1st, 2025! It’ll be available for $6.99 / £5.89 / €6.89, with a 10% launch discount during the first two weeks!

🌱 What’s in the full version?
Three game modes:
- 🪴 Classic Mode (with 4 difficulty levels)
- 🔥 Challenge Mode (featuring 12 unique challenges)
- 🏞️ Endless Mode (includes Rent and No-Rent variations)

24 character classes to choose from
8 biom es, each unlocking new items or buildings
30+ brand-new skill upgrades
240+ items and 30+ buildings to buy, craft, or construct
Full Steam Achievements support

🧠 Design Philosophy
At its core, Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth aims to rethink the traditional farming sim. You don’t need to walk over to crops to water them or trees to chop them down — just use your mouse (and okay, a little keyboard help) to handle everything with speed and precision. This means more time spent on planning, adapting, and making meaningful choices.

Get Ready NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760790/Another_Farm_Roguelike_Rebirth/
